query: Oh my gosh, I just got back from walking my golden retriever puppy earlier today, he kept stopping to sniff every dandelion on the sidewalk and even tried to carry a half-eaten popsicle stick home, I had to chase him for three whole minutes to get it away from him. Then I stopped by the neighborhood bakery on the way back, their new matcha croissant is so flaky and not too sweet, I already bought two more to freeze for next week. Oh, and I was rearranging my bookshelf last night and found my old copy of Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban that I thought I lost three years ago, it even has the little receipt from the school book fair tucked in the pages. Anyway, I need to cancel two pending orders first: order #W4836353 and order #W7342738, both for the reason that they're no longer needed. Then I need to return items from two delivered orders: for order #W4597054, please process the return of items 5669664287, 4900990404, 9862136885 and 6777246137, refund to gift_card_3491931; for order #W7773202, please process the return of item 8277474082, also refund to gift_card_3491931.
